name: slicerx
description: SlicerX, the AI-ready slicer, in Claude Code: slice and estimate 3D models, plan and check OrcaSlicer settings, diagnose failed prints, calibrate filament, run mimir skills on a project, theme an embedded SlicerX, and read and control printers on your network under a permission policy you set.

model_folders.title: Model folders
model_folders.description: Folders SlicerX may read models from, separated by colons, such as /Users/you/prints. Empty means any file you can read.

sx_path.title: SlicerX core (sx) path
sx_path.description: Full path to the sx slicer binary. Empty looks for sx on your PATH; without it SlicerX gives rough estimates only.

printers.title: Printers
printers.description: demo: five simulated printers. link: your real printers through sx-link on this computer. off: no printer tools.

link_code.title: sx-link pairing code
link_code.description: The code sx-link prints when it starts. Needed only when Printers is link.

policy_file.title: Permission policy file
policy_file.description: Path to your permission policy JSON. Empty uses ~/.config/slicerx/mcp-policy.json when it exists, else the defaults (queue, start and profile changes ask first).
